learningObjectives: Understand basic probability concepts used in data analysis.
Differentiate population parameters from sample statistics.
Identify how sampling supports statistical inference.

activities.title: Explore Probability
activities.instruction: Adjust the probability and observe how likely the event becomes.

content.concept: Probability represents the likelihood of an event occurring and ranges from impossible to certain.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Map Population and Sample
activities.instruction: Explore how a population, sample, parameter, and statistic are related.

content.concept: A population contains the full group of interest, while a sample is a subset used to estimate characteristics of that population.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: The complete group about which a study seeks information.
A subset selected from the population for analysis.
A numerical characteristic describing the population.
A numerical measure calculated from the sample.
Using sample evidence to draw conclusions about the population.

activities.title: Sequence the Sampling Process
activities.instruction: Arrange the steps of statistical sampling and inference in order.

content.concept: Statistical inference begins with defining a population, selecting a sample, analyzing it, and drawing conclusions while accounting for uncertainty.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Choose the Statistical Method
activities.instruction: Match each analytical goal with an appropriate statistical approach.

content.concept: Different analytical questions require different statistical methods, sampling strategies, and measures of uncertainty.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Estimate a population mean → Confidence Interval
Compare two group means → Hypothesis Test
Measure the relationship between numerical variables → Correlation
Draw conclusions from a sample → Statistical Inference
